name: Burger Fuel Group Limited
quirks: Fiscal year ends 31 March; reports FY (annual) and H1 (to 30 Sep) only. Franchisor: Total System Sales (NZ$111.4m FY2026) is ~4.5x group revenue (NZ$24.8m) and is the network KPI, held in the DuckDB kpis table not the CSV. EPS column is in CENTS (NZX convention). No COGS/gross-profit line is presented, so GrossProfit/OperatingIncome/EBITDA are legitimately empty. Zero bank debt; the ~NZ$21.5m of liabilities is almost entirely IFRS-16 lease liabilities from head-leasing sites and subleasing to franchisees, and the sublease interest income (NZ$0.785m FY2026) is exactly offset by an equal interest expense. No share-based payment scheme exists, so StockBasedComp is genuinely 0. June-2024 court-approved return of capital cancelled 30% of shares (50.337m -> 35.236m), breaking per-share comparability. FY2018/FY2022/FY2023 are press-release-only filings with no balance sheet or cash flow. CORRECTION: an earlier note claimed BFG delisted from the NZX in 2021 - this is wrong; it trades on NZSE (~NZ$0.32, Aug-2026).
